summary: Iteration 13 — Verified the new Job Hazard Plans hub + Trench Box Tabulated Data feature end-to-end. Backend: 160/160 pytest in 75.65s (141 carry-over + 19 new in test_jha_plans_and_trench_boxes.py covering all 11 endpoints, admin-token gating, upsert idempotency, file streaming, 404 paths, and full Trench Box CRUD with PDF attachment). Frontend smoke: Hub at / renders exactly 7 tiles including hub-tile-jha AND hub-tile-trench. /jha lands on the public JhaPlansHub with data-testid='jha-search' + 31-job list + 'NOT UPLOADED YET' badges. /trench-boxes shows the empty state. Legacy /jha/submit and /jha/new both redirect to /jha. Admin login with Happy123! lands on /admin showing admin-tile-jha-plans + admin-tile-trench-boxes (no legacy 'admin-tile-jha'). /admin/jha redirects to /admin/jha-plans. /admin/jha-plans renders 'Upload Plan' button + 31-job picker list. /admin/trench-boxes renders 'Add Box' + empty state. Full E2E smoke: POSTed a tiny base64 PDF for project_number=24-06, confirmed the /jha public page now shows data-testid='view-plan-24-06' with text 'VIEW PLAN' while all 30 other jobs remain 'NOT UPLOADED YET'. Cleanup performed — 24-06 test plan was DELETEd (returned {deleted:true}).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: POST /api/job-hazard-plans uses update_one({project_number}, {$set: doc}, upsert=True) — correctly idempotent per project (verified: two POSTs for same project_number result in exactly one row with the latest filename/notes). file_data blob is correctly stripped from list responses via the projection {'file_data': 0}.
server.py: DELETE /api/job-hazard-plans/{project_number} returns 404 when no plan exists and 200 {deleted:true, project_number} on success — clean.

server.py: POST /api/trench-boxes enforces manufacturer+model via .strip() (won't accept whitespace-only). Unlike the JHA upsert, trench boxes use a random uuid id per POST — so multiple boxes with the same model are allowed, which is the correct choice since a fleet can own duplicates of the same manufacturer/model.

server.py: PUT /api/trench-boxes/{box_id} preserves the existing tabulated_data_file when no new file is sent (it pops it from the $set). Verified the previously-uploaded PDF stayed attached after an update-without-file call.
JhaPlansHub.jsx + JhaPlansAdmin.jsx both share the JOB_LIBRARY as source of truth for the job list (31 jobs visible). Good single source.
App.js routing: legacy /jha/submit, /jha/new, /admin/jha, /admin/jha/* all confirmed redirecting — no orphan 404s from bookmarks.
Hub.jsx correctly renders 7 tiles in the new order; testids follow the 'hub-tile-<id>' convention for easy automation.

AdminHub.jsx: tile counts are computed on mount from /api/job-hazard-plans and /api/trench-boxes — counts are fresh per admin hub visit (not live). Not a bug, but a refetch on window focus or after admin CRUD actions would be a nice follow-up UX improvement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke-tested flows (Hub, /jha, /trench-boxes, legacy redirects, admin login, /admin, /admin/jha-plans, /admin/trench-boxes, end-to-end upload for 24-06 → visible as VIEW PLAN on public /jha)

test_credentials: ADMIN_PASSWORD=Happy123! from /app/backend/.env. X-Admin-Token obtained via POST /api/admin/login. conftest.py auto-attaches it to every requests.* call.
seed_data_creation: Test run created and then cleaned up: 1 JHA plan for project 24-06 (DELETEd at end). Trench box tests create TEST_-prefixed boxes and clean them up in teardown_class. No residual test data in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is at 160/160 across 11 test files. Run: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v` (~75s). The new feature (JHA Plans hub + Trench Box Tabulated Data) is fully wired: public GET endpoints + file streaming + admin-gated POST/PUT/DELETE + upsert-on-project_number. Admin token is a 64-char HMAC sha256 of ADMIN_PASSWORD — both login paths (frontend localStorage + conftest) derive the same value. For any future teardown: DELETE /api/job-hazard-plans/{project_number} and DELETE /api/trench-boxes/{box_id} both require X-Admin-Token. Frontend uses /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (axios) with an interceptor that reads localStorage['masci.admin.token'] and attaches X-Admin-Token on every request.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Feature is production-ready. All 19 new endpoint tests + 141 regression tests pass; frontend wiring (tiles, redirects, admin gates, upload flow) all verified end-to-end.
